thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — Runtime latency spike detected in canary pool rtm-canary-3. Severity: P2. Metric: hosted-api.generate p99 x5 over baseline. Triggered at 2026-03-17T15:12:00Z. Link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/5123459999

sam (eng-oncall): On it. Pulling logs and canary dashboard now.

eva (runtime): I see a big uptick in kernel_fallback_count on those hosts. Opening streaming logs.

lee (sre): Noted. Any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: release/2026-03-17T15:10:00 -> canary targets: rtm-canary-*. Flags: thinslice=true, batcher_window=adaptive.

sam (eng-oncall): that matches the window. thinslice=true rollout started 15:10. Could be kernel selection change.

eva (runtime): Log snippet from rtm-canary-3:
```
[15:11:58Z] model-server[pid=2145]: kernel_select: selected generic_kernel_v2 for model-7b (quantized)
[15:12:01Z] batcher: window_size=256 (was 32) -> processing latency 380ms
[15:12:03Z] kernel: fallback to generic_kernel_v2 because optimized_kernel failed init (OOM)
[15:12:05Z] kv_cache: evict_rate spike -> cache misses up 8x
```

manny (infra): OOM on optimized kernels suggests thinslice triggered a smaller slice packing change. That can increase memory per-worker.

lee (sre): Metrics: kernel_fallback_count +220 in last 5m on canary cluster, p99 latency +480ms, throughput -30%.

sam (eng-oncall): @deploy-bot can you pause/kill the thinslice flag for canary or rollback that slice config? Need immediate mitigation.

deploy-bot: Received request to toggle flag thinslice on canary scope. Proceed? react :white_check_mark: to confirm.

eva (runtime): Quick check: stable (non-canary) still on thinslice=false. So reverting will align kernels back to optimized path.

sam (eng-oncall): I'll flip. Lee, Manny — will you monitor kernel fallback and tail latency?

sam (eng-oncall): /ff set thinslice canary false  # flipping feature flag for canary pool now

deploy-bot: Feature flag update: thinslice=OFF for canary scope (changed by sam). Propagating config; expected converge ~30s.

incident-bot: Note: Page reassigned to lee (sre) at 15:18 for ongoing monitoring and postmortem.

lee (sre): Ack. Watching. Initial check: fallback_count dropping already on 3 nodes. p99 trending down.

manny (infra): Eviction/oom traces reduced. I'll scale up kernel init retries on canary just in case.

cs-rep (customer-success): Heads-up: Received two customer alerts about slowed response times for generation endpoints (AcmeCorp, VectorOps). No errors, just slow. Notified account teams.

sam (eng-oncall): Any customer-visible errors or just latency?

cs-rep (customer-success): Just latency right now. AcmeCorp flagged SLA breach for p99. They're on dedicated but routing through a canary edge path for testing — we should follow up.

lee (sre): Good catch, CS. Suggest we add a temporary traffic cutoff from canary for impacted customers until p99 fully stabilizes. @manny can you apply traffic policy?

manny (infra): On it. Applying routing override to send AcmeCorp traffic to stable pool.

manny (infra): Routing update applied at 15:23. Verified: AcmeCorp traffic -> stable-pool-2 (no thinslice). Monitor for errors.

cs-rep (customer-success): AcmeCorp confirmed latency improved after reroute. They want a short postmortem and ETA on permanent fix.

lee (sre): Current status: p99 across canary down from +480ms to +60ms over baseline. Kernel fallback events reduced by ~85%. We'll keep canary quiescent for 30m.

sam (eng-oncall): I'm going to mark this as mitigated but still in incident mode. Actions: 1) Roll back thinslice on canary (done). 2) Drain canary nodes and run kernele2 healthcheck. 3) Postmortem to detail regression cause and adjust canary gating.

deploy-bot: Canary drain initiated by sam at 15:25. Expected drain complete ~15:33.

lee (sre): Handoff: sam -> lee for monitoring and postmortem lead. Sam leaving oncall in 10m.

sam (eng-oncall): Handoff ack. Lee you have the page.

incident-bot: Incident update: Mitigated (P2 -> Monitoring). Customer impact: transient high latency for subset of customers, rerouted affected customers. Next step: postmortem scheduled in #postmortems. Owner: lee (sre).

cs-rep (customer-success): I'll draft an interim customer note for AcmeCorp and VectorOps, linking mitigation steps and ETA for full RCA.

lee (sre): Thanks all. Please add any logs/attachments to the incident doc: https://ops.redwood/incidents/5123459999/postmortem

manny (infra): Adding kernel init metrics and batcher window change logs to the incident doc.

sam (eng-oncall): final: thumbs up :thumbsup: Reassigning page to lee and closing active response.

deploy-bot: Closing active mitigation ticket at 15:30. Monitor for 1h.

lee (sre): Leaving note: root cause suspected: thinslice config induced kernel memory profile shift -> optimized kernel init failures -> fallback -> larger batch windows -> tail latency. Confirming exact sequence in postmortem.

cs-rep (customer-success): Logged customer follow-ups. Will update when RCA ready.

incident-bot: Incident state: monitoring. If regressions recur, auto-escalate to P1.

lee (sre): Acknowledged. Outgoing handover: I'll run next 30m watch and then prepare a 1-hr incident summary.
